title: Redux Toolkit
description: Model state with slices, wire the store with react-redux, and fetch server data with RTK Query.

data.text: Redux keeps application state in one store that can only change through dispatched actions. Redux Toolkit (RTK) removes the classic boilerplate: `createSlice` writes actions and reducers together, and Immer lets reducers be written with mutable-looking code.
A slice defines state and transitions

data.caption: src/features/counter/counterSlice.ts

data.title: Return the draft or mutate it — not both
data.text: Inside `createSlice` you can mutate `state` (Immer produces a new object) or return a new value, but mixing the two confuses the reader. Mutate the draft for consistency, and never mutate state outside a reducer.

data.caption: src/app/store.ts and a component using typed hooks
Wrapping the app and reading state

data.text: RTK Query treats remote data as a cache, not as hand-written loading flags. An API slice generates hooks with cache tags, so a mutation can invalidate the queries it affects.

data.caption: src/features/api/apiSlice.ts
Redux data flow: a dispatch becomes new state and a re-render
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    A[UI component] --> B[dispatch action]
    B --> C[Reducer slice]
    C --> D[Immer draft produces new state]
    D --> E[Store notifies subscribers]
    E --> F[useSelector re-renders affected components]

data.title: Install and add the Redux DevTools middleware
data.content: configureStore enables DevTools and thunk by default.
data.code:
npm install @reduxjs/toolkit react-redux
npm run dev   # inspect dispatched actions in the Redux DevTools browser extension

data.title: What interviewers look for
data.text: Be precise about "single source of truth, state is read-only, changes are made by pure reducers". Then add the modern part: RTK removed the boilerplate, Immer provides the mutable syntax, and RTK Query separates client from server state.

data.title: Key takeaways
points: createSlice combines actions and reducers; Immer enables draft mutation.
The store is created with configureStore and provided with <Provider>.
Typed useAppSelector/useAppDispatch hooks remove repeated generic annotations.
RTK Query caches server data and invalidates it with tags.
data.takeaway: Redux is still tested heavily — describe the data flow and why Redux Toolkit changed the recommended way of writing it.
